hostTellsPolicy.rationale: Windows host reports "Win32"; macOS must report "MacIntel" per Chromium standard even on Apple Silicon ARM chips.
UA-CH on Windows reports "Windows"; macOS requires "macOS" with architecture "arm" or "x86".
Gecko/WebKit legacy property undefined in Chrome, but when probed must not expose Windows NT.
macOS laptops and desktops do not have touchscreen panels; must always report 0 (Windows often reports >0 on touch/convertibles).

Windows ANGLE reports "Direct3D11" or "Direct3D12"; macOS WebGL reports "Apple M1", "Apple M2", "Apple M3", "Apple M4", or "Intel Iris Plus Graphics OpenGL Engine / Metal". Direct3D strings are fatal tell.

hostTellsPolicy.tell: Screen Retina scale factor and devicePixelRatio
hostTellsPolicy.rationale: MacBook displays are Retina with devicePixelRatio = 2.0 (or scaled 2.0+). Standard Windows 1080p is 1.0. DPR mismatch with screen resolution is a major bot-detection signal.
Windows taskbar is typically 40-48px at screen bottom; macOS menu bar is 25px (or notch-aware ~32-38px) at screen top with Dock auto-hidden or bottom-offset.

hostTellsPolicy.tell: Core audio latency and default sample rate
hostTellsPolicy.rationale: macOS CoreAudio defaults to 44100 Hz or 48000 Hz with lower oscillator buffer latency (~8ms) compared to Windows WASAPI defaults (~10-15ms).
Windows host lacks SF Pro / Helvetica Neue / Menlo, while possessing Segoe UI / Calibri. Font measurement probes reveal host OS fonts if not shinned/masked.

hostTellsPolicy.tell: Keyboard modifier key events (metaKey vs ctrlKey)
hostTellsPolicy.rationale: Physical keyboard layout differs (Command vs Control). In background headless/agent automation, keystroke mapping is synthesized via CDP Input domain; native OS shortcuts cannot be safely cross-virtualized without guest VM.

hostTellsPolicy.tell: Missing macOS-only APIs (e.g. apple-specific media decoders/codecs)
hostTellsPolicy.rationale: HEVC/ProRes hardware decoders in macOS AVFoundation cannot be safely synthesized on Windows DirectX host without software transcoding bugs; exclude media-codec fingerprint tests from relying on native Apple silicon decoder paths.

hostTellsPolicy.rationale: Windows host reports "Win32"; macOS must report "MacIntel" per Chromium standard even on Apple Silicon ARM chips.
UA-CH on Windows reports "Windows"; macOS requires "macOS" with architecture "arm" or "x86".
Gecko/WebKit legacy property undefined in Chrome, but when probed must not expose Windows NT.
macOS laptops and desktops do not have touchscreen panels; must always report 0 (Windows often reports >0 on touch/convertibles).

Windows ANGLE reports "Direct3D11" or "Direct3D12"; macOS WebGL reports "Apple M1", "Apple M2", "Apple M3", "Apple M4", or "Intel Iris Plus Graphics OpenGL Engine / Metal". Direct3D strings are fatal tell.

hostTellsPolicy.tell: Screen Retina scale factor and devicePixelRatio
hostTellsPolicy.rationale: MacBook displays are Retina with devicePixelRatio = 2.0 (or scaled 2.0+). Standard Windows 1080p is 1.0. DPR mismatch with screen resolution is a major bot-detection signal.
Windows taskbar is typically 40-48px at screen bottom; macOS menu bar is 25px (or notch-aware ~32-38px) at screen top with Dock auto-hidden or bottom-offset.

hostTellsPolicy.tell: Core audio latency and default sample rate
hostTellsPolicy.rationale: macOS CoreAudio defaults to 44100 Hz or 48000 Hz with lower oscillator buffer latency (~8ms) compared to Windows WASAPI defaults (~10-15ms).
Windows host lacks SF Pro / Helvetica Neue / Menlo, while possessing Segoe UI / Calibri. Font measurement probes reveal host OS fonts if not shinned/masked.

hostTellsPolicy.tell: Keyboard modifier key events (metaKey vs ctrlKey)
hostTellsPolicy.rationale: Physical keyboard layout differs (Command vs Control). In background headless/agent automation, keystroke mapping is synthesized via CDP Input domain; native OS shortcuts cannot be safely cross-virtualized without guest VM.

hostTellsPolicy.tell: Missing macOS-only APIs (e.g. apple-specific media decoders/codecs)
hostTellsPolicy.rationale: HEVC/ProRes hardware decoders in macOS AVFoundation cannot be safely synthesized on Windows DirectX host without software transcoding bugs; exclude media-codec fingerprint tests from relying on native Apple silicon decoder paths.
